target.acoustic_note: هَا + إِلَيْنَا are one continuous note: 415→465 Hz from 127.76, then 465→368 Hz to ≈129.15. There is no gap between the words.

L1_phrase.replaces: the whole phrase, including the continuous note

L2_word.replaces: فَأَدُّو; keeps the original هَا + إِلَيْنَا note

L3_syllable.use: if L2 fails; the floor (a single consonant cannot be comped)

generation.why: prefix = the note offset before the 0.36 s gap; the model sings the gap + phrase. 89 generated frames. A longer max does not change the word tokens (AR is causal); it gives the NAR trailing context through the breath.

stems.candidate: htdemucs vocals of each candidate (same model)

checks.shift: <= ±60 ms for L1/L2, <= ±20 ms for L3; no time-stretch

audition.L1: 3 shortlisted candidates on the full line 123.00-129.20
audition.L2: 2-3 candidates, same line, only if L1 fails
audition.L3: 1-2 candidates, same line, only if L2 fails

status: draft — wide-first ladder; the ear picks the level
notes: The ladder uses one render batch; only the comp window changes between levels.
The token re-derive + bit-identity gate is mandatory: this take has no exported semantic stream.
The guide's 'replace less' is a default, not a law. If L1 passes, the phrase-first workflow is the fast path.
Do not grind seeds if a whole level fails; change the text, use the donor, or regenerate.
